summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes 17-27 m away on the same side.
reasons: Homes 17-27 m away on own side

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 17 m (at 49 m), 20 m (at 52 m) and 27 m (at 40 m) on this side; more homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain sealed kerb on a wide road with a footpath behind; room beside the lane looks adequate.
drivers.traffic: Local through road with moderate traffic; a car sits parked on this kerb in the Esri image.
drivers.convention: Cars park here; No Stopping Any Time signs sit at the Handel Street corner, 0-15 m.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the corner, keep clear of 0-15 m
Slope about 2%, under the 3% steep line
sun_shade: Open to sun; street trees on the north side give patchy morning shade.

best_section.where: Meiers Road north kerb, west of the Handel Street corner, opposite the house with the pool-side garden
